payload.title: Two kernel readers still treat the frozen findings.jsonl as a finding's home: system_one cannot resolve an event-born finding, and the registry view cites findings.jsonl as its source
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md one owner per concept: the store layout has one reader, tools/gates/finding-registry-projection.ts; the kernel reads the registry only through run_registry_cli
payload.notes: Since MF-2 a finding born after the freeze exists only as docs/reviews/_registry/findings/<PREFIX>/<ID>.jsonl. system_one._finding reads findings.jsonl at refs/aria-public/heads/main and refuses such a finding as finding_not_registered (fails closed); read_registry_view stamps every row with source findings.jsonl, so an ingested event-born finding cites a file that does not hold it.
